sources.snippet: A 35M-parameter token tagger for personal data in Chinese and mixed Chinese-English text. It is a fine-tune of cjhwong/seatbelt-pii-tagger with the same architecture, tokenizer and 18 types / 73 BIOES labels. sources.snippet: Training and evaluation code for ickma2311/zh-pii-tagger-35m, a 35M Chinese / English PII token tagger fine-tuned from cjhwong/seatbelt-pii-tagger. The repository also includes zh-pii-ctx-heldout (data/e2.jsonl), a held-out set of 1,875 real Chinese passages with inserted synthetic private names and addresses.
